name.en: Paying for “winning numbers” for Boledo or the Jackpot Lottery

how.en: Pages and profiles on social media, or messages, claim to know the winning numbers for Belize government lottery games such as Boledo, the Ordinary or the Jackpot before the draw. They ask you to pay first. Belize Gaming & Lotteries says nobody can predict the numbers and it does not sell tickets through social media or messaging apps.

text.en: A page or message says it knows the winning numbers for the next draw.
You must pay or send a deposit before you get the numbers.
The numbers don’t win, and they ask for more money.
Boledo inside info 💯 tonight’s number guaranteed. 3 of my clients hit last week. Send BZ$50 by transfer and I inbox you the number 1 hour before the draw. Serious people only.

en: someone says they know the jackpot numbers before the draw
send money to get the winning number
Someone claims to know lottery results in advance.
You must pay before you get anything.
Tickets or numbers are sold through social media or a chat app.
Don’t send money or personal information.
Buy tickets only from authorised lottery vendors.
Report the page to Facebook and to the Belize Police Department.
